name: Ice Blade
body:
School evocation [cold]; Level: druid 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

Components: V, S, M (a small crystal)

Casting Time: 1 standard action

Range: 0

Effect: Sword-like beam

Duration: 1 min./level (D)

Saving Throw: Reflex half; see text; Spell Resistance: no

This arcane spell is similar to flame blade, but creates a cold, blue flame that causes cold damage. It cannot ignite objects, but it can freeze up to 1 cubic foot of water per caster level. Using the blade to freeze water requires a standard action. Creatures made of water are immune to the freezing effect.
